title: Membership
description: A time-bounded relationship between a person, organization, and optional post.

start.description: When the membership began, at the precision the source actually gives.

end.description: When the membership ends or ended, at the precision the source actually gives. Most sources publish only 'term expires 2029'.

partialDate.description: A date carrying only the precision the source published: a full ISO date (YYYY-MM-DD) where the source gives one, a month (YYYY-MM) where it gives only a month, or a year (YYYY) where it gives only a year. Consumers must handle all three and must not assume a missing month or day; a bare year is not a claim about January 1 or December 31.
